context:
Goal: one writing standard in every repo.
Problem (rule): the child repos still require STE, and work in another repo needs your word.
Based on (ruling): your 13:22 CST pick b, "drop STE everywhere".
Based on (read): q_max CLAUDE.md "Language standard" section; degen CLAUDE.md rule prose-is-ste.
Departs from: each child CLAUDE.md that requires STE — points at rule output-write-in-ste instead.
holds: Only the child repos' STE lines; #1105 goes ahead without it.

title: Should the other repos' CLAUDE.md files also drop Simplified Technical English?
why: Your 13:22 CST ruling said "everywhere". q_max, banchi, degen and joyous still name STE in their own CLAUDE.md files, and changing them is work in other repos.
